# Documents

Each document under docs/ says in its front matter what it is (tools/docs.py). Superseded ones
are left out here; each names what replaced it. docs/upstream/ holds others' text, as fetched.

## Current

How blaze is now. Kept true: CI checks their links, paths and settings against the tree.

- [architecture.md](architecture.md): A map of the code: the worker, the cargo drop-in, the splice, and how a build and an edit flow through them.
- [benchmarks.md](benchmarks.md): How long an edit takes to build, the memory and disk it uses and how fast its programs run, against cargo, on three platforms.
- [borrowck.md](borrowck.md): blaze's own borrow checker (hir-ty-borrowck): how it matches rustc's verdicts, how it is scored, what is left.
- [cache.md](cache.md): The disk store every daemon shares and the remote (a directory or S3) machines push to and pull from.
- [cargo.md](cargo.md): Every blaze command and setting: cargo's commands and flags, what a build does, sandboxing, manifests.
- [const.md](const.md): Const evaluation: blaze's own interpreter for constants and const fns, and what it covers.
- [contributing.md](contributing.md): How to build, test and change blaze: AI use, where new code goes, rules for code, working in parallel, landing.
- [doc.md](doc.md): blaze doc: HTML documentation written from the front end's HIR, with no rustdoc.
- [fn-cache.md](fn-cache.md): #[blaze::cache]: results of pure functions kept across runs, keyed by the code they reach.
- [fuzzing.md](fuzzing.md): The differential fuzzer: how it makes programs, runs them under cargo and blaze, and what it does not cover.
- [harness.md](harness.md): The harnesses that compare blaze with rustc, what each checks, and how CI runs them.
- [install.md](install.md): Installing blaze: the install script, the release channels and what gets installed.
- [live.md](live.md): Live edits: what happens between a save and the new code running in a program, and what is refused.
- [mir-passes.md](mir-passes.md): The MIR passes from built MIR to runtime MIR, ported from rustc, that codegen and the interpreter run on.
- [platforms.md](platforms.md): The state of each platform blaze runs on, from the last CI run that covered them all.
- [release.md](release.md): Releases: the canary and stable channels, how a release is cut and what gates promotion to stable.
- [resolve.md](resolve.md): Reading Cargo.toml and .cargo/config.toml as cargo does (blaze-manifest), compared with cargo by harness/resolve.py.
- [support.md](support.md): What is supported, cell by cell, each pointing at the report or harness run behind it.
- [tiers.md](tiers.md): Tiers: hot functions of a live program compiled again with LLVM and swapped in while it runs.
- [toolchain.md](toolchain.md): blaze's own pinned nightly: what it is, how it is fetched and checked, and the daily bump.
- [usage.md](usage.md): Getting started: using blaze on a project, in short.
- [web.md](web.md): The build page blaze ui serves: every function of the build drawn live on the GPU, from a Flecs world of the program.

## Plans

Designs not (fully) built, newest first.

- [linker.md](linker.md) (2026-10-28): blaze's own linker: one patch engine with a lasting layout, writing to a running process or an executable, replacing cc, lld, ld64 and link.exe.
- [future/const-macros.md](future/const-macros.md) (2026-10-28): Const macros: proc macros written inline as const fn, run by the const evaluator. Stage 0 is experimental.
- [driver.md](driver.md) (2026-10-28): The build driver as a graph that does no IO: what is wrong with the serial driver and what replaces it.
- [remote-cache.md](remote-cache.md) (2026-10-27): One shared remote cache for CI and everyone: the gateway, the CAS API, and the slices built and to come.
- [closure.md](closure.md) (2026-10-27): The closure build scripts run with: what is fetched and laid out (built), and the mount namespace (not yet).
- [self-contained.md](self-contained.md) (2026-10-25): blaze self-contained: one curl install that builds any Cargo project with no rustup, toolchain or cargo.
- [roadmap.md](roadmap.md) (2026-10-24): blaze-next, the floor of an edit for agents: content-addressed VFS, VM forks, sans-IO core, the agent API.
- [ci-runner.md](ci-runner.md) (2026-10-24): A CI runner on ix VMs: a warm blaze VM per repository and a fork per branch. Design, nothing built.
- [no-rustc.md](no-rustc.md) (2026-10-22): The no-rustc rule and the plan to remove every rustc use, step by step, with what is done.
- [glancer.md](glancer.md) (2026-10-21): A front end more like Rust Glancer: six ideas, where time and memory go, and the ordered steps.
